svg.aria-label: A conveyor loop on a bench. A black puck, the user's intent, rides a chain past seven stations: 1 usage explodes, a pin board whose pins shoot up; 2 the meter arrives, a meter that steps from flat to pay-as-you-go; 3 cap the natives, a screw clamp that presses down on the puck; 4 go personal, a cabinet whose hatch opens on a phone; 5 personal accounts train, a recording drum and its training toggle; 6 intent becomes the roadmap, a tray of 30 compartments filling into a map; 7 the spike eats the 80%, a press driving a spike into the dense middle of a map. At station 3 a points switch can shunt the puck off the loop into a fenced pen marked 8 OWNED, so the loop never reaches 4.
